name: aji-kitchen
description: Aji's Kitchen — home catering platform (client + server)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
